traits.description: The unit can not attack after moving, or move after attacking.
When attacking, enemies do not retaliate against this unit.
Deals damage in all four cardinal directions when attacking.
This unit's attacks do not do damage. Attacks on empty tiles instead deploy a landmine.
At the end of each turn, recover 15 health.
This unit is invisible to your enemy unless they are right next to it.
After attacking, refresh this unit's movement action.
Lose all health points after attacking.
This unit's attacks do not do damage, and instead heal the target for 50 hp.
